December 4, 1938. Morning Translation

Standard :-

ASSASSINATION OF A "REFORMED GOVERNMENT" OFFICIAL

The following is a biography (compiled by our reporter) of Chu Koh-ping (諸國屏), Chief of the Soochow-Wusih-Changchow Garrison Corps of the "Reformed Government", who was shot dead on November 28 at the intersection of Chekiang Road and Avenue Edward VII :-

Chu, aged 41, was a native of Changchow. At one time he was a regimental commander under Marshal Feng Yu-hsiang (馮玉祥) but was dismissed and came to Shanghai where he eked out a living by managing law-suits on behalf of others. About three years ago he was entrusted by Voong Dee (鳳弟), an 18-year old concubine of a former Ching Dynasty Tsotai named Liu (劉), to open negotiations with her husband over certain matters, as a result of which the concubine received $7,000 and she later became Chu's concubine. With this money Chu secured an appointment as Chief of the River Police of Soochow, Wusih and Chang-chow. Upon hearing that Chu was keeping another concubine at Wusih, Voong Dee went to Wusih and laid a complaint before the authorities and he was removed from office. He then came to Shanghai with his wife and two concubines.

FILE

On the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese hostilities last year, he assembled the men who formerly served under him and was appointed by the National Government as Chief of the Third Corps of the Kiangsu-Chekiang Movement Committee. After the withdrawal of the Chinese forces from Shanghai, his men were reorganized into mobile units to disturb the rear of the Japanese forces. It is said that several of the big terrorist cases in Shanghai had been carried out by his men and as a consequence the Japanese authorities paid close attention to him. Subsequently, his avarice led him to betray his country for he accepted the post of Chief of the Soochow-Wusih-Changchow Garrison Corps of the "Reformed Government" and undertook certain activities against the mobile units. For this he was deeply trusted by the Japanese, but there were many people who were anxious to lay hands on him. Chu's last visit to Shanghai was in connection with a very important matter: to plan the murder of a certain high official residing in Shanghai. He took elaborate measures to conceal his movements and the reports current last month that he had been killed by Japanese at Changchow were spread by him as a smoke-screen. However, he was shot dead soon after his arrival here.

标准：-

“维新政府”官员遇刺案

以下为“维新政府”苏锡常驻防军司令诸国屏（Chu Koh-ping）的生平简介（由本报记者编纂），他于11月28日在浙江路与爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）交叉口被枪杀：-

诸，41岁，常州人。他曾任冯玉祥（Feng Yu-hsiang）元帅麾下的团长，后被免职来到上海，靠代人打官司谋生。约三年前，他受前清道台刘（Liu）氏的一名18岁妾室凤弟（Voong Dee，音译）之托，就某些事项与其丈夫进行谈判，结果该妾室获得7,000元，随后她成为了诸的妾室。凭借这笔钱，诸谋得了苏州、无锡和常州水上警察局长一职。当得知诸在无锡另纳妾室后，凤弟前往无锡向当局投诉，导致他被撤职。随后，他携妻子和两名妾室来到上海。

档案

去年中日战事爆发时，他召集了昔日部下，并被国民政府任命为江浙运动委员会第三团团长。中国军队从上海撤退后，其部下被重组为流动部队，以扰乱日军后方。据说上海发生的几起重大恐怖案件均由其部下所为，因此日本当局对他密切关注。后来，贪婪使他背叛国家，因为他接受了“维新政府”苏锡常驻防军司令的职务，并从事针对流动部队的活动。为此他深得日本人信任，但有许多人急于将他抓获。诸最后一次来上海是为了处理一件非常重要的事情：策划谋杀一名居住在上海的高级官员。他采取了周密的措施来掩盖行踪，上个月流传的他已在常州被日本人杀害的消息，是他散布的烟幕弹。然而，他抵达此处后不久即被枪杀。

At 4.02.p.m. 28-11-38, a telephone message
was received from C.P.C.1644 per Street Telephone
to the effect that a male Chinese had been shot and
lay fatally wounded on Chekiang Road near Ave.Ed.VII.

Upon receipt of the message, Station
detectives under C/I Chamberlain and D/I Bennett
attended and upon arrival found a male Chinese as
described, laying in a pool of blood on the roadway,
West side of Chekiang Road about 20 yards North of
Avenue Edward VII.

The Fire Brigade Ambulance which had been
summoned by Inspt. Gash arrived on the scene soon
after the arrival of Police and conveyed the injured
person to the Lester Chinese Hospital.

Doctor's Chit states:-

"Brought in dead".

A search was made in the vicinity of the
crime, this resulting in six spent cartridge cases
being picked up by C.P.C.2516 on the roadway outside
of No.9 Chekiang Road, i.e. the premises outside of
which the deceased had been fatally shot.

Enquiries made in the vicinity at this stage
of enquiries failed to locate any witness to the
shooting, pedestrians, shop assistants and hawkers
who abound in this vicinity all averring that
although they heard several shots fired yet they did
not see the persons firing same, whilst as the
crowd in this vicinity were running away from the
scene of the shooting they could not single out any
person as being possibly responsible for this crime.

1938年11月28日下午4点02分，通过街道电话收到来自中央巡捕房（C.P.C.）1644号的电话消息，称一名中国男性在浙江路靠近爱多亚七世路（Ave.Ed.VII）处被枪击，身受致命伤躺在那里。

收到消息后，由警长Chamberlain和侦探长Bennett率领的捕房侦探赶赴现场，到达后发现一名如上所述的中国男性躺在浙江路西侧、爱多亚路以北约20码处的路面上的一滩血泊中。

由Gash督察召唤的消防队救护车在警察到达后不久抵达现场，并将伤者送往莱斯特华人医院（Lester Chinese Hospital）。

医生便条写明：-

“送医时已死亡”。

随后在犯罪现场附近进行了搜查，结果中央巡捕房（C.P.C.）2516号在浙江路9号外的路面上捡到了六个空弹壳，即死者被致命枪击处的屋外。

在此阶段的调查中，在附近进行的问询未能找到任何枪击目击者，该地区众多的行人、店员和小贩均声称，虽然他们听到了几声枪响，但没有看到开枪的人，而且由于该地区的人群正从枪击现场跑开，他们无法指认出任何可能对此罪案负责的人。

NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS,
NOV 29 1938
Another Murder in
Troubled Louza
Political Motive Seen in
Avenue Edward Shooting;
Desperadoes Escape

Yet another murder of a Chinese
took place in the Louza district
yesterday afternoon when unidenti-
fied desperados riddled their victim
with pistol bullets at the crowded
intersection of Chekiang Road and
Avenue Edward VII, and escaped.
The target for the assassins' fusillade
who died almost instantly, was Chu
Koh-ping, 42, a native of Changchow
who was formerly an employee of the
Garrison Commander's office of the
new "regime." No-one else was
wounded.

The bold attack occurred at exactly
3.55 o'clock. Apparently the gunmen
waylaid their victim, who was on
foot, and sprayed him with bullets
at close range. His head and body
had six wounds, attesting six direct
hits, when examined later at the
Lester Chinese Hospital, where he
was taken in a Fire Brigade am-
bulance. Two automatic pistols were
used, one being of .38 calibre and
the other a .32.

Possibly more than six shots were
fired by the murderers, but only the
half dozen took effect in the victim's
body. The rain of bullets naturally
caused a panic among pedestrians
and others at the populous crossing
and made scores of persons scamper
into alleyways and shops in search
of safety. It was considered remark-
able that no-one else was hit by the
fusillade.

Political Motive?

The body was taken to the Public
Mortuary last night. The man was
of the "loafer" type, to which the
Chinese terms "pi-san" or "liu-mang"
are applied. The murder was sus-
pected to be of political nature, and
hence detectives of the S.M.P. Head-
quarters special homicide office were
called in to assist Louza Station in
the investigation.

As a result of yesterday's assassina-
tion and two previous ones, all of
which took place in the same dis-
trict inside four days, the police
redoubled their efforts last night to
comb the Louza lodging-house
neighbourhoods and alleyways for
suspicious characters. Search-parties
operated at regular intervals and
many suspects were challenged both
on the street and in houses. Head-
quarters detectives also made a
number of raids through the day
and evening.

Other Victim Identified

His fingerprints yesterday identified
the Chinese who was shot in a Can-
ton Road lodging-house on Sunday
night. The man was wounded in the
head at 9 p.m. that evening while
in room 40 of the Pao Woo Lodging
House, Lane 420, Canton Road. He
died in the Lester Chinese Hospital
about two hours later. Only one
bullet was fired, from a .32 calibre
automatic pistol.

The victim was subsequently
identified by fingerprint experts who
found that he possessed a criminal
record in Shanghai, having been
handed over to the Chinese authori-
ties here by the Settlement Police in
1932 to answer to a charge.

His murderer escaped from the
Canton Road lodging-house and has
not been identified. The motive for
the killing was probably political
also in this case.

《字林西报》，
1938年11月29日
老闸区动荡中再发命案
爱多亚路枪击案疑有政治动机；暴徒逃脱

昨天下午，老闸区又发生了一起中国人被杀案件， unidentified desperados（身份不明的暴徒）在浙江路与爱多亚路拥挤的十字路口用手枪子弹将受害者打得千疮百孔，随后逃脱。刺客齐射的目标是朱国平（Chu Koh-ping），42岁，常州人，曾是新“政权”卫戍司令部的雇员，他几乎当场死亡。没有其他人受伤。

这起大胆的攻击恰好发生在3点55分。显然，枪手伏击了步行的受害者，并在近距离向他扫射。后来在莱斯德华医院（Lester Chinese Hospital）进行检查时，发现他的头部和身体有六处伤口，证实有六次直接命中，他是被消防队救护车送往该医院的。凶手使用了两支自动手枪，一支为.38口径，另一支为.32口径。

凶手可能发射了超过六发子弹，但只有这六发击中了受害者的身体。弹雨自然在人口稠密的十字路口引起了行人和其他人的恐慌，使得数十人逃入小巷和商店寻求安全。值得注意的是，齐射中没有其他人被击中。

政治动机？

尸体昨晚被送往公共停尸房。此人属于“无业游民”类型，中文称为“皮三”或“流氓”。谋杀案被怀疑具有政治性质，因此工部局警务处总部特别凶杀股的侦探被召来协助老闸捕房进行调查。

由于昨天的刺杀案以及此前两天内发生在同一地区的另外两起案件，警方昨晚加倍努力，搜查老闸区的旅馆街区和小巷，寻找可疑人物。搜查队定期行动，许多嫌疑人在街道上和房屋内受到盘查。总部侦探也在白天和晚上进行了多次突袭。

另一名受害者身份确认

通过指纹，昨天确认了周日晚上在广东路一家旅馆被枪杀的中国人的身份。当晚9点，该男子在广东路420弄宝武旅馆40号房间内头部中弹。约两小时后，他在莱斯德华医院死亡。只发射了一发子弹，来自一支.32口径的自动手枪。

随后，指纹专家确认了受害者的身份，发现他在上海有犯罪记录，曾于1932年被租界警察移交给此处中国当局以应对指控。

他的凶手从广东路旅馆逃脱，身份尚未确认。在此案中，杀人动机可能也是政治性的。

SHANGHAI TIMES.
NOV 29 1938
Crime Wave
Sweeps City
During Day
Late Woosung Garrison
Officer Assassinated
On Avenue Edward
IMPORTANT ARRESTS
MADE BY POLICE

A crime wave, unprecedented in several months, broke out in Shanghai yesterday, when one Chinese, believed to be a former officer of the Woosung Garrison, was shot on Chekiang Road, while a series of four armed robberies were committed in different parts of the Settlement during the early hours of the evening. The police, however, were active, and it was reported late last night that important arrests had been made both in the French Concession and in the Settlement, including the apprehension of 10 suspects believed to be implicated in several major crimes committed recently.

While no confirmation was obtainable, a strong rumour was circulated in various quarters last evening to the effect that among the 10 persons rounded up by the police, several were alleged to be involved in the assassination of Loh Lien-kwei, former Chinese Superintendent of the Municipal Police, who was killed two months ago in the Oriental Hotel, Nanking Road.

Pistols Found
Meanwhile, in the early stages of police investigations last night, three pistols were found among the possessions of the suspects.
The men were taken into custody from various places in the French Concession and International Settlement, being quarters in disreputable lodging houses.
Deeper investigations were being pushed by detectives attached to Settlement Police beyond press-time early this morning.

Officer Shot
Detectives of Louza Police Station last night were interrogating a young Chinese witness in connection with the murder of Chu Kuo-ping, 42, a former captain in the Woosung Garrison, who was shot four times by a lone gunman at the intersection of Chekiang Road and Avenue Edward VII, shortly before 4 o'clock yesterday afternoon.
The victim, who received bullet injuries in the forehead and chest, succumbed to his wounds within a few minutes of the shooting, while the gunman managed to make his escape in the large crowd present in the vicinity at the time.
The witness to the attack, a young Chinese bill-board painter, was being detained by the police for further questioning this morning.

Armed Robberies
Shortly after 6 o'clock last evening a gang of seven Chinese, three of them armed with pistols, entered the premises at 18 Lucerne Road and after intimidating the inmates, took money and jewellery to the value of $600. Although no alarm was raised, one of the robbers fired his pistol carelessly and wounded himself in the right leg and had to be assisted by two other members of the gang when they made their getaway.
A lone Chinese pedestrian was held up on Great Western Road by a gang of eight men, only one of whom was armed with a short pistol, at 6.50 p.m. yesterday. After taking their victim into an alleyway, the robbers relieved their victim of $60 in cash and then escaped in the direction of Bubbling Well.
Four Chinese, all of them armed with Mauser pistols, entered a Chinese residence at 130 Brenan Road at 7 o'clock last night and after intimidating the occupants, stole $75 in cash and then decamped.

虽然无法获得证实，但昨晚各方流传着一种强烈的谣言，称在警方拘捕的10人中，有几人涉嫌参与两个月前在南京路汇中饭店遇害的前工部局警务处华务总监罗连贵（Loh Lien-kwei）的暗杀案。

发现手枪
与此同时，在昨晚警方调查的初期阶段，在嫌疑人的物品中发现了三支手枪。
这些人是从法租界和公共租界各处的住所被带走的，这些住所位于名声不佳的寄宿房屋内。
截至本报今晨付印时，隶属于租界警方的侦探正在进行更深入的调查。

军官遭枪击
昨晚，老闸捕房的侦探正在审讯一名年轻的华人证人，该证人与42岁的前吴淞驻军上尉朱国屏（Chu Kuo-ping）被杀案有关。朱国屏于昨日下午4点前不久，在浙江路与爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）交叉口被一名单独行动的枪手连开四枪击中。
受害者额头和胸部中弹，在枪击发生后几分钟内因伤重不治身亡，而枪手则趁当时现场聚集的大量人群逃脱。
袭击案的目击者是一名年轻的华人广告牌画师，今晨被警方拘留以接受进一步讯问。

持械抢劫
昨晚6点过后不久，一伙七名华人闯入卢森堡路18号，其中三人持有手枪，在恐吓屋内人员后，抢走价值600元的现金和珠宝。虽然无人报警，但其中一名劫匪不慎走火，击中自己的右腿，在逃跑时不得不由另外两名同伙搀扶。
昨晚6点50分，一名独行的华人大西路行人遭到一伙八人拦路抢劫，其中仅一人持有短柄手枪。劫匪将受害者挟持至一条弄堂后，抢走其60元现金，随后向静安寺方向逃窜。
昨晚7点，四名均持有毛瑟手枪的华人闯入勃伦南路130号的一处华人住宅，在恐吓住户后，偷走75元现金，随即逃匿。

Eastern Times :-

THE MURDER OF A FORMER WUSIH POLICE CHIEF

At 4.15 p.m. yesterday several shots rang out
in quick succession at the crowded intersection of Chekiang
Road and Avenue Edward VII. During the commotion a man of
medium height was noticed lying on the ground in front of
the Lao Dao Shiang Tsung Candy Shop (老稻香村 ), No.9
Chekieng Road, his body riddled with bullets. He was
dressed in a blue serge padded long gown, dark woollen
jacket and Chinese shoes. His hair was closely cropped.
According to one Zee Kwdi-ling (徐桂林 ),
native of Ningpo, a crab stall keeper at the entrance of
Sungkiang Alleyway (松江弄 ), who witnessed the shooting,
the victim, who had crossed over from the French Concession,
was waylaid near the Sungkiang Alleyway by three ordinarily
dressed men, two of whom produced pistols and fired seven
shots at him, killing him instantly. The assailants then
made good their escape.
It is learned that the murdered man was one
Chu Kok-ping (諸國屏 ), age 46, native of Changchow, who
was the Chief of the Soochow-Changchow-Wusih Garrison Corps.

《时报》：

前无锡警察局长遇害

昨日下午4点15分，在浙江路与爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）熙熙攘攘的交叉口，接连响起数声枪响。在混乱中，人们注意到一名中等身材的男子躺在浙江路9号老稻香村糖果店门前的地上，身中多弹。他身穿蓝色哔叽棉长袍、深色毛呢夹克和中国式鞋子。头发剪得很短。
据一位名叫徐桂林（Zee Kwdi-ling，音译）的宁波籍目击者称，他是松江弄口的一名蟹摊摊主，目睹了枪击过程。据他描述，受害者从法租界过来，在松江弄附近被三名衣着普通的男子伏击，其中两人掏出手枪向他开了七枪，致其当场死亡。袭击者随后成功逃脱。
据悉，被杀者名为诸国屏（Chu Kok-ping），46岁，常州人，曾任苏常吴驻军团司令。

November 29, 1938.
Morning Translation

At the time of his death he had in his possession two cents
and a pass issued by the Japanese military authorities, on
which his address was given as No.22 Teh Sing Li (德馨里),
Keshing Road.
Chu was formerly a regimental commander in the
North-western Army, but was dismissed by Marshal Feng Yu-
hsiang because of his bad reputation. After giving up
his army career, he returned to his native place at Chang-
chow where he remained until the outbreak of the Sino-
Japanese hostilities last year. After the withdrawal of
the Chinese troops from Changchow, he, together with a
number of loafers and army deserters, first oppressed the
people by levying taxes and later they surrendered to the
Japanese who organized them into a Soochow-Chengchow-Wusih
Garrison Corps of which he was appointed Chief. The Corps
is about 700 strong and well equipped. However, the
Japanese had failed to pay his men their wages of $20 each
a month as promised. About two months ago, the Corps was
disarmed and he was arrested by the Japanese as he had
refused to render assistance to the Japanese soldiers in
the campaign against guerrillas. He was taken to Soochow
and possibly through the efforts of certain persons he was
later released.
Chu came to Shanghai four days ago in company
with several others and was staying in Room No.22 of
the Liang Chi Lodging House (梁溪旅館), Hoopeh Road. He
had many acquaintances among the loafers in the western
District of Shanghai. Last night one Zung Foo-sung(陳富生)
and one Ching (金) invited him to supper, so he hurriedly
returned to the lodging house in the hope of meeting his
friends at the appointed time.
It is said that Chu had some experience of
military operations and was a good Chinese scholar. He
often wrote scrolls for others. On the day following his
arrival in Shanghai, he went to the Ta Sing tailor shop
(大新) on Foochow Road and ordered an overcoat.

Standard and other local newspapers :-

It is ascertained that the man who was murdered
yesterday at the intersection of Chekiang Road and Avenue
Edward VII was one Chu Koh-ping, age 42, native of Chang-
chow, who was formerly the Chief of the Police Defence
Corps at Wusih. He lived at No. 12 Ferry Road near the
Kawamura Memorial Tower. He used to write scrolls for
others for a living. His son-in-law, Tsu Vee-ming
(朱維明), native of Wusih, is a painter with an office
in the accountant's room of the Liang Chi Lodging House,
No.144 Hoopeh Road.
The Police are investigating the murder.

他去世时身上带有两分钱和一张由日本军方当局签发的通行证，上面注明的地址为克兴路德馨里22号。
朱氏原为西北军的一名团长，但因声誉不佳被冯玉祥元帅撤职。放弃军旅生涯后，他回到家乡常州，一直居住到去年中日战事爆发。中国军队从常州撤退后，他与一群无赖和逃兵一起，起初通过征收税捐压迫百姓，后来向日本人投降，日本人将他们编组为苏常吴驻军团，并任命他为司令。该团约有700人，装备精良。然而，日本人未能按承诺每月支付其部下每人20元的薪饷。大约两个月前，该团被解除武装，他因拒绝协助日军进行反游击战行动而被日本人逮捕。他被带到苏州，可能通过某些人的努力，后来获释。
朱氏四天前与其他几人一同来到上海，住在湖北路梁溪旅馆22号房间。他在上海西区的那些无赖中有许多熟人。昨晚，陈富生（Zung Foo-sung，音译）和一位金姓人士（Ching）邀请他共进晚餐，因此他匆忙返回旅馆，希望能按时与朋友会面。
据说朱氏有一些军事作战经验，且汉学功底良好。他经常为他人书写条幅。抵达上海的第二天，他去福州路的大新裁缝店定做了一件大衣。

《标准报》及其他本地报纸：

经查实，昨日在浙江路与爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）交叉口被杀的男子名为朱国平（Chu Koh-ping），42岁，常州人，曾任无锡警察保卫团团长。他居住在河滨路川村纪念塔附近的12号。他以替人书写条幅为生。他的女婿朱维明（Tsu Vee-ming），无锡人，是一名画家，办公地点位于湖北路144号梁溪旅馆的会计室。
警方正在调查这起谋杀案。
